description: This file contains shell functions for verifying firmware image signatures and metadata, likely used during firmware upgrade processes on embedded devices. It includes functions such as fwtool_check_signature and fwtool_check_image that perform validation checks on firmware images and their signatures.

methods.name: fwtool_check_signature
methods.description: Verifies the signature of a firmware image using fwtool and ucert, with optional handling for image signature requirements.

methods.name: fwtool_check_image
methods.description: Checks the presence and validity of image metadata and compatibility for a firmware image before upgrade, including device compatibility and version checks.
